entries.label: Peace Walker — Playa del Alba
entries.prompt: Create ONE wide 16:9 empty static HD painted 2D fighting stage source for CQC Versus Legacy, based carefully on the attached original-game reference. Preserve each game's specific place, architecture, palette and materials. Continuous horizontal walkable fighting strip at the front. Remove every person, vehicle, HUD, scope reticle, annotation, logo and text. No collage, no spritesheet, no UI. Peace Walker PLAYA DEL ALBA training beach on Costa Rica's Caribbean coast. Follow the supplied PSP opening-area image: sun-bleached pale coastal rock outcrop, weathered timber planks in the sand, rusted chain-link gate across the passage toward the inland path, banana/palm foliage above the rocks, humid pale yellow sky. Wide empty beach foreground with compact pale tan sand, timber training platform and the distinctive chain-link gate/rock passage in the middle background, a narrow strip of blue-grey sea visible at one edge only. A few plain stacked wooden supply crates at the far side, no training dummy figure, no guns or targets, no signs/lettering. Original PSP earth and olive palette, no lush resort makeover.

notes: Location and episode checked against the listed screenshot references.
Static painted HD source; perspective, hidden surfaces and fine textures are adapted and not certified as exact 1:1.
No animation, collision layout, parallax separation or runtime admission.
